create_grpc_server: create a gRPC server with a thread pool, generic handlers, interceptors, and options
add_generic_rpc_handlers: add generic RPC handlers to an existing gRPC server instance
add_insecure_port: add an insecure port to a gRPC server for plaintext communication
add_secure_port: add a secure port to a gRPC server with TLS credentials
stop_grpc_server: stop a running gRPC server with an optional grace period for pending RPCs
